subject: art-design
title: Drawing Skills: Tone & Form
welcome_lead: Turn flat shapes into solid form with tone and shadow.
meta_desc: KS3 drawing: shading, light source, shadow, form and 3D illusion.
final_note: Tone is what makes a flat circle become a sphere.

concepts.def: How light or dark something appears.
The brightest spot where light hits an object.
Darkest tone on the object opposite the light.
Shadow thrown by the object onto a surface.
The 3D quality of an object in a drawing.
A strip showing tones from light to dark.

walkthroughs.body_html: Before you shade, decide where the light comes from. Everything else follows: the highlight faces the light, the core shadow sits opposite, and the cast shadow falls away from the light.
Practice a tonal scale with 5 steps: highlight, light, mid-tone, core shadow, reflected light. Apply these to a sphere and you will see flat paper become round.
Form is the illusion of three dimensions. Use tone, not outline, to suggest a curved surface. Soft transitions read as round; sharp transitions read as edges.
